description: Golden execution vectors against fixtures/cross-runtime/graph.json (source name 'g'). 'plan'/'expect' are generated by the .NET reference implementation (dotnet/Rql.Conformance regen) and reviewed; other runtimes execute 'plan' (and 'thenPlan') and must match 'expect' (diagnostics compared by severity+code only).

cases.name: recurse-include-self
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Id Name $type

cases.name: is-subtype
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where $ is Special | select Name Power

cases.name: is-base-type
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where $ is Node | count

cases.name: enum-eq-string-ci
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Kind == "alpha" | select Name

cases.name: enum-eq-number
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Kind == 2 | select Name

cases.name: numeric-gt
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Value > 5 | select Name Value

cases.name: null-vs-missing
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Note == null | select Name

cases.name: is-not-null
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Note is not null | select Name Note

cases.name: has-member
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where has(Power) | select Name

cases.name: kleene-not-missing
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where not (Power > 100) | select Name

cases.name: contains-ci
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Name contains "A" | select Name

cases.name: starts-with-ci
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Name starts-with "b" | select Name

cases.name: string-eq-case-sensitive
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Name == "b-2" | count

cases.name: list-contains
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Tags contains "red" | select Name

cases.name: list-count-method
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Tags.count() == 0 | select Name

cases.name: list-count-member
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Tags.Count == 2 | select Name

cases.name: len-fn
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where len(Tags) >= 2 | select Name len(Tags)

cases.name: any-pred
cases.rql: g.Nodes | where Children.any(Enabled == false) | select Name

cases.name: all-pred-empty-true
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Children.all(Enabled) | select Name

cases.name: map-member
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name Props.hp

cases.name: map-key
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name Props["armor"]

cases.name: struct-member
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Pos.x < 0 | select Name Pos.x Pos.y

cases.name: sort-desc
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | sort Value desc | select Name Value

cases.name: sort-multi-enum
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | sort Kind, Name desc | select Kind Name

cases.name: sort-nulls-last
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | sort Note | select Name Note

cases.name: sort-nulls-last-desc
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | sort Note desc | select Name Note

cases.name: sort-ordinal
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | sort Name | select Name

cases.name: first-n
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | first 2 | select Name

cases.name: distinct-key
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | distinct Kind | select Kind

cases.name: distinct-identity
cases.rql: g.Nodes | get Peer | distinct | select Name

cases.name: group-by
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | group-by Kind

cases.name: group-by-then-sort
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | group-by Kind | sort count desc, key | first 2

cases.name: group-by-then-filter
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | group-by Tags.count() | where count > 1 | select key count

cases.name: group-by-null-key
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | group-by Note | where key is null

cases.name: sum
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | sum Value

cases.name: min
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | min Value

cases.name: max-string
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | max Name

cases.name: object-summary
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name Parent

cases.name: generic-recurse-owning-only
cases.rql: g | recurse | where $ is Node | count

cases.name: recurse-cycle-safe
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Peer max-depth=5 include-self=true | select Name

cases.name: recurse-max-depth
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children max-depth=1 | select Name

cases.name: in-list
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Value in [7, 3] | select Name

cases.name: not-in-list
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Kind not in ["Alpha", "Beta"] | select Name

cases.name: matches
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Name matches "^a-\\d$" | select Name

cases.name: lower-fn
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where lower(Name) == "b-2" | select Name

cases.name: coalesce
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name x=coalesce(Note, "none")

cases.name: precedence
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Enabled and Value >= 7 or Kind == "Gamma" | select Name

cases.name: bang-not
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where !Enabled | select Name

cases.name: missing-in-select
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name Power

cases.name: select-then-filter
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name v=(Value) | where v > 2 | sort v | select Name

cases.name: truncation
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | select Name

cases.name: mut-set-scalar
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where Id == 2 | set Value = 1

cases.name: mut-err-integral
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where $ is Special | set Power = 1.5
cases.then: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where $ is Special | select Power

cases.name: mut-err-atomic
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | set Power = 5
cases.then: g.Nodes | recurse Children include-self=true | where has(Power) | select Power
